profile.headline: Advisor Application Desginer/AI Lead at Gainwell Technologies
profile.jobTitle: Sr Software Engineer - Sr Professional Application Designer
profile.summary:
I am currently an Advisor Level Software Engineer and AI Lead with experience in software development and design in healthcare working with Medicaid. Years of relevant corporate work experience makes me a top-notch client-facer and a super-communicator.  

18+ years of experience in executive-level management of real estate residential & commercial transactions and software engineering & development. I have years of pilot testing for technological software programs, spatial programming, loan processing & closing, financial analysis, marketing, and client relations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS: 

•       Knowledgeable in Python, C, C#, Linux, SQL, and JavaScript with great knowledge of its functionalities
•	 Proficient in database structures, Databricks Certified, and SQL using Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres
•	 Familiar with the use of ORM and Dapper in SQL
•	 Familiarity with the .NET framework (v5 and above), .NET Core, and .NET Core MVC
•	 Proficient in HTML & CSS
•	 Proficient understanding of code versioning tool: Git
•	 Good understanding of object-oriented programming
•	 Ability to write clear, concise, and readable code
•	 Experience building RESTful API & JSon with CRUD functionalities
•	 Previous experience working in Agile/Test Driven Environments
•        Experienced in SDLC with emphasis in QA and UAT
•	 Familiarity with various design and architectural patterns, Entity Framework, & Mongo DB
•       CI/CD & DevOps: Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git/GitHub, Git Bash, pipeline automation, Gradle, Autosys
•       Containerization & Cloud: Docker (working knowledge), AWS (EC2), Linux/Unix
  


SOFTWARE KNOWLEDGE: 
Development: C, C#, Python, Databricks, Linux/Unix, Jenkins, Visual Studio, VS Code, Git Hub/Bash, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, Razor, MongoDB, JSON, SaaS, Figma, PuTTY, DBeaver, Autosys, Powershell, AzureDevOps, AWS, EC2

Vocational: MS Office Suite, Salesforce, AWS, Encompass, Tableau, Compensafe, Ellie Mae AIQ, Mortgage Hippo, CoreLogic Credco, Credit Plus, Loansphere/Black Knight, Excel, Microsoft Office Suite, Argus, Apto, Pardot, LexisNexis, CoStar, LandVision, DocuTech, DocuSign

Graphic Design: Adobe: InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop
